description: OverridesStore cross-SDK conformance: pluggable persistence for system.control.update_config and system.control.toggle_feature. Verifies file-backed persistence, startup load-and-apply order, in-memory variant for tests, and missing-file-on-first-run tolerance (Issue #45.1, D-40).

test_cases.description: After save() returns, the override is durable: a fresh FileOverridesStore reading the same path MUST observe the value via get() / get_all().
On APCore startup with both a base apcore.yaml and an overrides file, override values MUST take precedence over base values for the same key. The base file is unmodified.
InMemoryOverridesStore behaves identically to FileOverridesStore for the four operations but performs no disk I/O. Two separate InMemoryOverridesStore instances do NOT share state.
Constructing FileOverridesStore with a path that does not yet exist MUST succeed (treat as empty store). The first save() call MUST create the file.
delete() removes the override and persists the removal. Subsequent get_all() MUST NOT include the deleted key. Deleting an absent key is a no-op.
